summary: Dark Elf foundation and five sea-raider templates

profiles.name: Dark Elf

traits.name: Hatred
traits.adaptation: Legacy: core Hatred uses a Psychology Test and the current Melee/Ranged and immunity rules, replacing the p. 18 summary.

traits.name: Night Vision
traits.adaptation: Legacy: core Night Vision works in natural darkness without the dim-light prerequisite printed on p. 18.

profiles.adaptation: Legacy: core Hatred and Night Vision replace the differing p. 18 summaries; printed Characteristics, Wounds and Damage are unchanged.
notes: Generic GM foundation only; this is not a playable Dark Elf Species. Printed optional Armour 3 is an unspecified protection profile, not invented pieces.
Printed Weapon +7 is unnamed. Optional Ranged +9 has range 60 yards and no named weapon. Optional Spellcaster requires an explicit Lore.

templates.name: Chief Mate

talents.adaptation: Legacy: Core Dual Wielder uses Fifth Edition two-weapon/free-attack and Parry rules, replacing the p. 18–19 reversed-dice, off-hand and defence penalties.
Legacy: Core Furious Assault loses Momentum for the additional attack; the printed Move alternative on p. 19 is not retained.
Legacy: Core In-fighter uses an Opposed Melee Action to begin in-fighting and its Improvised Weapon rules, replacing the p. 18–19 longer-weapon immunity/+10 summary.
Legacy: Core Menacing grants Advantage on Intimidation, replacing the p. 19 +1 SL summary.
Legacy: Core Pilot grants Advantage on Row and Sail, replacing the p. 18–19 failed-roll reversal.
Legacy: Printed Public Speaking uses core Public Speaker: group Charm Advantage and subsequent Leadership, replacing the p. 19 five-times audience effect.
Legacy: Core Sea Legs grants Advantage when a seasickness Test is required, replacing the printed abnormal-condition penalty immunity.
Legacy: Core Strong Swimmer grants Swim Advantage and +2 SL in swimming Pursuits, replacing the p. 18–19 breath-holding Toughness Bonus.

gear.label: Leather or Mail Armour
gear.adaptation: Legacy: unspecified Leather/Mail Armour uses core Light/Medium quick armour, following the previously approved conversion.

notes: Template Skill bonuses use the higher of existing advances and the printed bonus, following the reviewed core-template interpretation. All printed Characteristic columns are applied exactly; current core Talent definitions govern.
Dark Elf users may add a Sea Dragon Cloak; its printed additional Body 2 AP/Partial and maintenance are references pending the acquired-armour clarification.
templates.adaptation: Legacy: current core Talent definitions replace the specific older effects explained on the affected Talent grants.
